_about: Hoy launch emails (NT-02, NT-03) for Company OS comms 1.5.0. Generated by `node scripts/gen-launch-emails.mjs` from src/notifications/launchEmails.ts in imagine-os/hoy: edit the source, not this file. `records` replaces the recipe's message_template and automation blocks; also merge `settings` and apply `retire`.

settings._note: MERGE these into the recipe's module settings: without them booking.hold_frozen, booking.hold_resumed and booking.moved are never written and three emails never send. reschedule_hours goes on together with policy_as_of_booking (ADR 0039). link_base_url is the app address behind {{links.base}}. email_from, and email_reply_to when it is set (the contact email, H-8), must be on a domain in MESSAGING_EMAIL_ALLOWED_DOMAINS. Dates render in the recipient person's locale: Hoy writes person.locale es (or none) so dates stay Spanish.

brand._pending: J5: brand and domain are pending with Jas. Change src/tenant/tenant.ts and regenerate.

templates.name: Bienvenida
templates.trigger: Alguien crea su cuenta de cliente

templates.name: Código para entrar
templates.trigger: Alguien pide un código para entrar (lo envía Clerk)

templates.name: Reserva pendiente de pago
templates.trigger: Llega el comprobante de una reserva retenida y recepción lo revisa

templates.name: Pago confirmado
templates.trigger: Se aprueba un pago sin producto (los pagos de un producto reciben la Nota de compra)

templates.name: Pago rechazado
templates.trigger: Recepción rechaza el comprobante de una reserva y la reserva vuelve a esperar el pago

blockers.gap: booking.hold_resumed fires for a declined, voided, deleted or re-pointed pending payment alike, and a decline after the class start releases the hold instead (booking_released).
blockers.needs: bookings: a reason detail on hold_resumed / hold_released (declined | voided | deleted | repointed | expired), so the automation can filter on declined.

blockers.gap: A declined receipt for a package (no booking) writes no event of its own; record.updated carries only field names, so a filter cannot tell a decline.
blockers.needs: payments: audit payment.declined { id, person, amount, product, for_entity, for_id } when a payment becomes declined; then a purchase-decline template (this one names the booking's class and hold).

templates.name: Reserva liberada
templates.trigger: Se acaba el tiempo para pagar una reserva retenida y el cupo se libera

templates.name: Reserva cambiada
templates.trigger: Una reserva pasa a otra clase

templates.name: Clase cancelada por el estudio
templates.trigger: El estudio cancela una clase con reservas

blockers.gap: A studio cancel (occurrence → cancelled) cancels the bookings by direct writes with no audit event per booking, and an automation sends to one recipient per event.
blockers.needs: bookings: audit booking.cancelled_by_studio { id, occurrence, person } for each active booking a studio cancel cancels, in the same transaction.

templates.name: Bono recibido
templates.trigger: Se crea un bono de regalo o de cortesía con el correo de quien lo recibe

templates.name: Nota de compra
templates.trigger: Se aprueba el pago de un producto y Company OS emite la Nota de compra

templates.name: Comprobante nuevo (a recepción y administración)
templates.trigger: Un cliente sube un comprobante de pago

blockers.gap: An automation's recipient must be a path (event.… or record.…); a fixed team inbox can't be named, and no record holds it.
blockers.needs: comms: let recipient_email be one literal address (or a settings path such as settings.team_email).
Jas: the front desk and administration addresses, on the verified sender domain.

rows.name: welcome

rows._note: bookings 1.4.0 with hold_frozen_while_payment_pending: a pending payment for a held booking freezes the hold (details { id, payment }).
rows.name: booking_pending_payment

rows._note: payments 2.5.0: payment.approved { id, person, amount, product } once per payment. A product payment also gets invoice.issued, so it is answered by purchase_note instead: one email per approval.
rows.name: payment_confirmed

rows._note: bookings 1.4.0: a declined (or voided, deleted, re-pointed) pending payment restarts the frozen hold: booking.hold_resumed { id, payment, hold_until }.
rows.name: payment_rejected

rows._note: bookings 1.2.0: booking.hold_released { id, occurrence, person, hold_until } (the job, or the next write that reads the class).
rows.name: booking_released

rows._note: bookings 1.4.0: booking.moved { id, person, from, to }; the booking keeps its id, its start follows the new class.
rows.name: booking_moved

rows._note: credits 1.1.0: voucher.created { id, kind, classes, valid_until, recipient_email, recipient_name, buyer }; the code is read from the record.
rows.name: voucher_received_gift

rows._note: A courtesy voucher without a recipient email is logged skipped (recipient_missing); the desk hands the code over.
rows.name: voucher_received_courtesy

rows._note: payments 2.6.0: invoice.issued { id, kind, number, payment, product, total }; Hoy issues receipts (payment_document: receipt, no VAT, J9).
rows.name: purchase_note

retire._note: The recipe's placeholder rows these replace. apply-recipe only upserts, so on a tenant where the old recipe already ran, set active: false on these automations FIRST, then on these templates (a template an active automation uses can't be deactivated: template_missing). Otherwise every approval, release and gift sends twice. welcome keeps its key and name and is overwritten in place.

blocked_automations._note: files 1.1.0: file.confirmed { fileId, kind, published } once the upload is confirmed; payments declares kind receipt on payment.
